name: A finding's file reference opens the app's own diff at that file
description: From PR #482's Agent runs tab, click the file:line reference on the seeded CRITICAL finding ('src/config.ts:11') and confirm it switches to Files changed with ?file= and ?line= in the URL and the file rendered. This is the in-app counterpart of the GitHub link that used to sit there — the ↗ icon beside it still goes to GitHub. Unlike the hover peek panels, this path is fully scriptable: the finding card on the PR detail page is open by default (FindingsTab passes defaultOpen to the newest run), so the reference is clickable without a hover. Read-only seeded data (no model call). Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api (PR #482) is the first repo — run locally via the hermetic stack (see e2e/README.md).
